{{Youmay|Nina, a character from [[Harvest Moon DS]] and [[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]|Nina's character in [[Nina (AWL)|A Wonderful Life]], or [[Nina (SoSAWL)|Story of Seasons: A Wonderful Life]]. Her appearance is not to be confused with the bachelorette going by the same name}}
{{Nihongo|Nina|アンナ|Anna}} is a character in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]] ''and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]].''

Nina moved to [[Forget-Me-Not Valley (DS)|Forget-Me-Not Valley]] to enjoy her retirement with her husband [[Galen (DS)|Galen]]. She's a kind old woman who loves nature. Her and Galen live alone in their small hut near the Circus Grounds.

Despite the fact that she looks old and frail, Nina is quite active. She can be seen out in the valley each day and spends most of her day near the Turtle Pond.

Nina will also give you a stocking for the Winter Festival if you befriend her to 200 points or more and give her a ball of yarn before the 25th of Winter.

Nina is an experienced midwife, and will help Dr. Hardy deliver your child. After the birth of your child, Nina dies.
